name: Dead Cells: Return to Castlevania - Signature Edition
summary:
The Signature Edition version of ‘Dead Cells: Return to Castlevania’, featuring the following delectable and collectable extras:

Standard copy of the game with retro reversible cover unique to Switch and Playstation

Unique Signature Edition outer sleeves

Alternative disc soundtrack featuring 28 original Castlevania tunes re-imagined in a Dead Cells style

Collection of 4 enamel pins

Exclusive art book

5 snapshot photos souvenirs of the Beheaded in Castlevania

Lenticular castle card

4 ‘Dead Cells: Return to Castlevania’ postcards featuring printed signatures

Special edition collectors box
